links.comparator_used: GPT-4's initial responses without a reading-level instruction (and Google search answers)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level and Flesch Reading Ease) of CDA FAQ responses
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid grade level 6.58 vs 13.06 (initial GPT-4) vs 12.24 (Google), P<0.001; Flesch Reading Ease 76.20 vs 36.87 vs 40.05, P<0.001
links.quote: Upon prompting GPT-4 to improve the readability of its responses, GPT-4 showed a lower Flesch-Kincaid grade level (6.58 vs. 13.06 vs. 12.24, P<0.001) and a higher Flesch Reading Ease score (76.20 vs. 36.87 vs. 40.05, P<0.001).
